description.value:
Samsons rebuilt Corporate Plaza. NovelTech built the Atlas for the next job: every city the Unification War left in pieces. It has an engineer's mind and a crane's back, and NovelTech leases them to contractors by the hundred.

Cost: 23,900eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 58 (17d6)
Frame: Omega (16): BODY 16
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Anti-Dazzle ×2, Enhanced Holophone, Mechatronic Core, Radiation Detector, Subdermal Armor, Techscanner (arm), Titanium Bones, Tool Hand ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
